mapper.insert: insert into issue_projection_outbox_reliability(tenant_id,outbox_id,projection_id,operation_sequence,projection_version,canonical_document_hash,mapping_version,credential_version,provider_request_fingerprint,status,claim_owner,claim_token_hash,claim_until,heartbeat_at,row_version,retry_after_at,rate_limit_reset_at,verification_mode,external_idempotency_marker,last_attempt_id,last_error_code,last_error_message,sent_at,acknowledged_at,created_at,updated_at,lane_id,lane_sequence,generation) values(#{value.tenantId},#{value.outboxId},#{value.projectionId},#{value.operationSequence},#{value.projectionVersion},#{value.canonicalDocumentHash},#{value.mappingVersion},#{value.credentialVersion},#{value.providerRequestFingerprint},#{value.status},#{value.claimOwner},#{value.claimTokenHash},#{value.claimUntil},#{value.heartbeatAt},#{value.rowVersion},#{value.retryAfterAt},#{value.rateLimitResetAt},#{value.verificationMode},#{value.externalIdempotencyMarker},#{value.lastAttemptId},#{value.lastErrorCode},#{value.lastErrorMessage},#{value.sentAt},#{value.acknowledgedAt},#{value.createdAt},#{value.updatedAt},#{value.projectionId},#{value.operationSequence},1) on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update issue_projection_outbox_reliability set status=#{value.status},claim_owner=#{value.claimOwner},claim_token_hash=#{value.claimTokenHash},claim_until=#{value.claimUntil},heartbeat_at=#{value.heartbeatAt},row_version=row_version+1,retry_after_at=#{value.retryAfterAt},rate_limit_reset_at=#{value.rateLimitResetAt},verification_mode=#{value.verificationMode},last_attempt_id=#{value.lastAttemptId},last_error_code=#{value.lastErrorCode},last_error_message=#{value.lastErrorMessage},sent_at=#{value.sentAt},acknowledged_at=#{value.acknowledgedAt},updated_at=#{value.updatedAt} where tenant_id=#{value.tenantId} and outbox_id=#{value.outboxId} and row_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select * from issue_projection_outbox_reliability where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and outbox_id=#{outboxId}

with due as (select r.tenant_id,r.outbox_id from issue_projection_outbox_reliability r where r.status in ('PENDING','FAILED_RETRYABLE','VERIFYING') and coalesce(r.retry_after_at,r.created_at)<=#{now} and (r.claim_until is null or r.claim_until<#{now}) and not exists(select 1 from issue_projection_outbox_reliability p where p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and p.lane_id=r.lane_id and p.generation=r.generation and p.lane_sequence<r.lane_sequence and p.status not in('ACKNOWLEDGED','DEAD_LETTER','CANCELLED')) order by coalesce(r.rate_limit_reset_at,r.retry_after_at,r.created_at),r.lane_id,r.generation,r.lane_sequence,r.created_at for update of r skip locked limit #{limit}) update issue_projection_outbox_reliability r set status='CLAIMED',claim_owner=#{workerId},claim_token_hash=pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(r.outbox_id||':'||#{workerId}||':'||clock_timestamp()::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),claim_until=#{claimUntil},heartbeat_at=#{now},row_version=r.row_version+1,updated_at=now() from due where r.tenant_id=due.tenant_id and r.outbox_id=due.outbox_id returning r.*
mapper.update: update issue_projection_outbox_reliability set heartbeat_at=#{heartbeatAt},claim_until=#{claimUntil},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=now() where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and outbox_id=#{outboxId} and claim_owner=#{workerId} and claim_token_hash=#{claimTokenHash} and row_version=#{expectedVersion} and claim_until>#{heartbeatAt}
mapper.select: select * from issue_projection_outbox_reliability where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and (#{status} is null or status=#{status}) order by updated_at desc limit #{limit}
